payload.summary: Planned a durable, dynamic merge-plan orchestration for the merge-pull-requests skill. Selected the tiered storage approach (coordinator system-of-record + file projection, degrade to file). Specified the full two-phase architecture; scoped implementation to Phase 1 (file-tier artifact + --execute --pr <n> + downstream re-validation). Motivated by a real triage session where state had to be rebuilt by hand after a context clear and a mid-flight joserfc CVE re-ordered the cohort.

decisions.title: Tiered plan storage: coordinator system-of-record + file projection, degrade to file
decisions.rationale: Only approach satisfying both solo-dev/offline and multi-host dispatch; reuses work_queue/merge_queue/event_bus instead of a new subsystem.

decisions.title: Separate plan definition from live state
decisions.rationale: Different lifecycles: definition is a reviewable snapshot, live state is hot/concurrent. Conflating them breaks multi-host dispatch.

decisions.title: Living plan: execution may insert discovered prerequisites
decisions.rationale: A static plan cannot represent a blocker found mid-execution (the joserfc CVE case).

decisions.title: Security-check backstop is normative
decisions.rationale: Execution SHALL defer to the auto-mode classifier rather than auto-bypass a failing required security check.

decisions.title: Spec deltas contain Phase-1 behavior only; Phase 2 lives in design.md
decisions.rationale: Keeps the archived capability spec honest — no claiming coordinator behavior that isn't built.

next_steps: /implement-feature add-merge-plan-orchestration — start with task 1.1 (plan schema + producer tests).
